title: GAM-Integration-Debugger Output
description: Structured diagnostic result from the GAM GPT integration analysis.

root_cause_summary.description: Precise technical explanation of the root cause. One to three sentences. Must name the specific API call or structural error. No hedging language.

severity.description: 'critical' — issue prevents ad rendering entirely. 'warning' — ads may render but with degraded performance or non-standard behavior.

original_problematic_lines.description: Verbatim lines from the submitted snippet that contain or constitute the defect. If the problem is an omission, include a note string describing what is absent.

suggested_code_fix.description: Complete, corrected GPT implementation. Must be self-contained and runnable as submitted. Must not be empty. A response without a code fix does not satisfy this schema.

examples.root_cause_summary: googletag.enableServices() is invoked before googletag.defineSlot() and before enableSingleRequest(), violating the required GPT initialization sequence.
